question: Must the same manner of ritual placement extend to the left arm as well?
premises: The preceding instructions specify placement at facial locations.
The verse adds the left arm as a location.
The verse marks this addition as performed in the same manner.
inference: The same manner of placement is also to be performed on the left arm.
uncertainties: Whether īdṛśaṃ functions adverbially or qualifies an implied object is not fully explicit.
plain_english: And also in the left arm, in the same manner.
